candidates.name: Moe Point Maid Cafe
candidates.nameJa: 萌えポイントメイドカフェ
candidates.description: A moe point is the trait fans love most in a character, like glasses, twintails, or clumsiness. The name celebrates how every maid brings her own flavor of cuteness to the cafe.

candidates.name: Moe Magic Maid Cafe
candidates.nameJa: 萌えマジックメイドカフェ
candidates.description: A nod to the moe "magic" maids perform at the table, like food blessings and the aikome power-up.

candidates.name: Rebloom Maid Cafe
candidates.nameJa: リブルームメイドカフェ
candidates.description: A fresh start for our cafe, told through flowers. Cherry blossoms and florals have long been part of our graphics and table decorations.

candidates.name: Minna To Maid Cafe
candidates.nameJa: みんなとメイドカフェ
candidates.description: Minna to (みんなと) means "with everyone": a maid cafe for and with our whole community. It also playfully echoes minato (harbor), a nod to our Bay Area home.

candidates.name: Okaeri Maid Cafe
candidates.nameJa: おかえりメイドカフェ
candidates.description: Okaeri (おかえり) means "welcome home," the greeting we say to every guest all day long. Note: Several existing businesses use "Okaeri," including a Japanese bistro in SF. Our social media handle would have to vary based on availability on each platform.

candidates.name: Welcome Home Cafe
candidates.nameJa: ウェルカムホームメイドカフェ
candidates.description: The English version of our greeting to every guest. Home is where the heart is, and while Fanime was our home for many years, our maids are the true home of the cafe.

candidates.name: Yumemiru
candidates.description: Yumemiru (夢見る) means "to dream,". It describes a place where our maids can pursue their goals and aspirations. Note: This name is thematically similar to the existing Dreamland Maid Cafe. Please consider whether it feels distinct enough, and let your vote reflect that.

candidates.name: Hoshicolle Maid Cafe
candidates.description: Hoshi colle (星コレ) means "star collection,". Each maid is a star in our shared constellation. A heart-shaped jar of origami stars was proposed as the central image.

candidates.name: Hoshi Heart Maid Cafe
candidates.nameJa: 星ハートメイドカフェ
candidates.description: Hoshi (星) means "star." The name pictures a heart-shaped jar full of origami stars, with each maid as a star in our community. It ties into the hearts throughout our past branding and the origami paper we keep at every table. Note: This name sounds similar to the existing Ai Hoshi Cafe. “Ai” means love, so both names pair love/hearts with “hoshi” (star). Please consider whether it feels distinct enough, and let your vote reflect that.

candidates.name: Maid Day Cafe
candidates.description: Named after May 10, "Maid Day," the same date our sister brand 5.1 Play is named for, creating a natural tie-in between the two.
